description: Pinned Weston / libweston dependency for the LinuxDroid Android GUI.

platform.archComment: Only arm64-v8a / API 36+ is supported. No x86, x86_64, or ARM32 targets are built or packaged.

toolchain.buildToolComment: libweston is built with Meson. Meson is the upstream, authoritative build system for Weston/libweston; the Android Gradle/CMake externalNativeBuild path cannot build the upstream Meson tree, so an isolated Meson cross-build is used for this dependency (see README.md).

libweston.rendererComment: Milestone 1 establishes the libweston dependency only. The renderer strategy for later milestones is Pixman (bring-up) then GLES/EGL (production) then Vulkan (future/optional).

dependencies.libffi: libffi is required to cross-build libwayland.
dependencies.waylandScanner: wayland-scanner is a HOST tool consumed by the libweston Meson build at configure time.
dependencies.policyComment: Weston 16.0.0's meson.build unconditionally requires the above pkg-config dependencies at configure time; only the linkedByLibweston subset is linked into libweston-16.so. All are cross-built by native/weston/bootstrap-deps.sh. The full Weston desktop stack is NOT built.
